context:
Goal: banchi's browser tests run as fast as they safely can, and no flaky test is hidden.
Problem (rule): the decision to keep one worker per shard rests on a failure rate the measurements now contradict, and only you can rewrite a settled decision's reason.
Based on (measured): 0 of 19 first-try reds in the last 100 main runs were the Escape-key test (flake records in banchi PR #1007).
Based on (read): the decision cites the Escape-key test's one-in-thirteen red rate as its reason.
Departs from: main, whose decision says workers stay at one because of that one-in-thirteen red — the reason becomes "that red is not seen on the runner now (0 of 19 recent reds)", and the cites in the CI config and a later decision point to the new flake record.
holds: Nothing waits on this; the lane does other work.

options.gain: You and the lanes can trust why CI runs one worker per shard; CI speed and flake risk do not change.
options.how: The decision and its cites say what is measured now; CI stays at one worker per shard.
options.label: Rewrite the reason, keep one worker
options.lose: A speed-up that may now be safe stays untried.

options.gain: banchi's browser tests may get faster.
options.how: As (a), plus a lane runs two workers per shard and measures the red rate before it stays.
options.label: Rewrite, and try two workers
options.lose: More tests share each worker, the very thing the old Escape red was blamed on, so there is flake risk until it is measured.

options.how: The decision keeps its old reason.
options.label: Leave it
options.lose: Anyone weighing a CI speed-up is misled by a red rate that no longer happens.

ref: banchi decision D136 (the browser suite is split into shards, never widened); banchi PR #1007, now in integration PR #1017
reply: Routed 00:58 CST to the banchi lane. Correction from the lane, 01:00 CST: the question rested on an old fact. Your Sep 19 word already moved banchi to two workers per shard (twelve shards at two workers each), so the two-worker trial is moot. Only the decision's text and its old failure-rate cite were stale; a lane is rewriting them now. A real speed trial would be three workers per shard, which no one is raising now.
title: banchi: the reason for one browser worker per shard no longer holds. Rewrite it, and try two?
why: banchi keeps one browser-test worker per shard because an Escape-key test was red once in thirteen runs. In the last 100 runs on main, none of the 19 first-try reds was that test. Rewriting a settled decision's reason needs your word.
